checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are largely accurate but slightly lenient on the 'Label area' checkpoint. While labels exist, the complete failure to render legible text (confirmed by the Text Auditor returning empty blocks) means the checkpoint 'displaying track information...' is technically not met in a functional sense, though visually present as a blob. The Router correctly marked fine molded details as untestable due to resolution/occlusion. The geometric checkpoints are correctly verified as present.
artifact_review: The Router identified text gibberish (Severity 2), texture anomalies (Severity 1), and structural collapse (Severity 2). The Text Auditor confirms the gibberish is severe (empty extraction), supporting a Severity 2-3 rating for text artifacts. The Topology Auditor's mask confidence (0.84) is moderate, suggesting some boundary ambiguity which aligns with the Router's 'texture anomaly/edge bleeding' observation. The 'structural collapse' in the bottom-right cassette is a valid concern; AI often warps rigid rectangular objects. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions, which is consistent with local geometric/text artifacts rather than global blur/noise. I agree with the severity ratings, perhaps nudging text gibberish to 2.5 given the total lack of coherence.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'cassette' (Logit 7.75 vs 4.04 for next best), ensuring high semantic alignment. Most geometric checkpoints (shape, spools, windows) are visually present and correct. The primary deduction comes from the functional failure of the labels (illegible text) and minor geometric warping in peripheral objects, preventing a perfect score.
artifact_reasoning: Significant text gibberish on all labels (Text Auditor returned empty results) is the dominant artifact. Minor edge bleeding and plastic texture inconsistencies (Topology/Router observations) contribute to the artifact score. The slight geometric warping of the bottom-right cassette adds to the structural imperfection. These are typical mid-tier AI generation artifacts: good global structure, poor local detail fidelity.
key_defects: Minor geometric warping of rectangular cassettes (bottom-right)
Soft/ambiguous boundaries between overlapping plastic casings
